methodology.mix: Equal deposit, withdrawal and internal transfer counts
methodology.isolation: Every scenario in a fresh Node process and fresh chain; startup and enrollment excluded from timed load
methodology.scope: Resource figures include EVM and workload driver, plus HTTP server in workflow mode. They exclude browser and parent orchestrator. Shared host, no CPU reservation.

resources.scope: One isolated Node worker: Ganache EVM, RPC client and load driver; HTTP server also included in workflow mode. Excludes browser and parent orchestrator.

valid.message: Receipt exactly matches the mined transaction.

altered.message: Receipt fields do not match the blockchain.

demonstration.note: Historical receipts from an isolated evaluation chain. Run npm run demo for receipts on your own local chain.
